sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 118

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 118:1
items.html: From the Chazeh downward of Yetzirah and Assiyah descended, because of the sin, to the place of the fourteen lower Sefirot, and clothed themselves in the dwelling place of the Klipot. And on Shabbat they have an ascent to Atzilut. Therefore the taking out of the feet outside the Shabbat boundary — which is the aforementioned Chazeh [chest] — is forbidden, so as not to bring them down again to the place of the Klipot, as they were during the week. (Items 96 and 97).
